# Therapist Resources

> Courses, workbooks and clinical tools for therapists.

## Pages
- [Professional Courses | Rindie Eagle](https://therapistresources.com/courses): Enroll in professional development courses for therapists. Expand your clinical skills with expert-led training.
- [Therapist Resources - Rindie Eagle (MA, LPCC)](https://therapistresources.com/): Professional therapy resources, courses, and digital products designed by Rindie Eagle. From session-ready materials to clinical tools, everything you need with no prep time required.
- [Web Apps & Tools | Rindie Eagle](https://therapistresources.com/web-apps): Interactive clinical tools and web applications for therapists. Streamline your practice with our Caseload Calculator and Behavioral Definition Builder.
